body.value:
PT_401A(
    PV_High := 2.0,
    PV_Low := 1.6,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
PT_401B(
    PV_High := 2.0,
    PV_Low := 1.6,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
PT_401C(
    PV_High := 2.0,
    PV_Low := 1.6,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
TT_105(
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
TT_106(
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
TT_107(
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
PVT_401(
    Input1 := PT_401A.PV,
    Input2 := PT_401B.PV,
    Input3 := PT_401C.PV,
    Deviation_Limit := 0.09,
    Voting_Scheme := '2oo3',
    EnableAlarm := TRUE);
TVT_402(
    Input1 := TT_105.PV,
    Input2 := TT_106.PV,
    Input3 := TT_107.PV,
    Deviation_Limit := 2.0,
    Voting_Scheme := 'Median',
    EnableAlarm := TRUE);
PIC_401(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := PVT_401.Voted_Output,
    SP := 1.8,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0);
TIC_402(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := TVT_402.Voted_Output,
    SP := 65.0,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0);
PV102_Inhibit_OR := PVT_401.Alarm_Voting_Error OR PIC_401.PV_High_Alarm OR PIC_401.PV_Low_Alarm;
I_401(
    Bool_In := PV102_Inhibit_OR,
    Alarm_OnTrue := TRUE,
    Latch_Enable := TRUE);
PV_102(
    Control_Signal := PIC_401.XOUT,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Timeout := T#10s,
    Inhibit := I_401.Bool_Out);
FV107_Inhibit_OR := TVT_402.Alarm_Voting_Error OR TIC_402.PV_High_Alarm OR TIC_402.PV_Low_Alarm;
I_402(
    Bool_In := FV107_Inhibit_OR,
    Alarm_OnTrue := TRUE,
    Latch_Enable := TRUE);
FV_107(
    Control_Signal := TIC_402.XOUT,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Timeout := T#10s,
    Inhibit := I_402.Bool_Out);
AllPTBad_AND := PT_401A.General_Fault AND PT_401B.General_Fault AND PT_401C.General_Fault;
XV_104(
    Open_Cmd := FALSE,
    Close_Cmd := AllPTBad_AND,
    Timeout := T#5s,
    Inhibit := AllPTBad_AND);
MasterAlarm_OR := PV102_Inhibit_OR OR FV107_Inhibit_OR OR PT_401A.General_Fault OR PT_401B.General_Fault OR PT_401C.General_Fault OR TT_105.General_Fault OR TT_106.General_Fault OR TT_107.General_Fault;
MA_401(
    Bool_In := MasterAlarm_OR,
    Alarm_OnTrue := TRUE,
    Latch_Enable := TRUE);

(* Outputs published to other sections / HMI. *)
PVT_401_Voted_Pressure := PVT_401.Voted_Output;
TVT_402_Voted_Temperature := TVT_402.Voted_Output;

FT_601A(
    Raw_Signal := FT601A_Raw_mA,
    PV_High := 4500.0,
    PV_Low := 100.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 312.5,
    Scaling_Offset := -1250.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
FT_601B(
    Raw_Signal := FT601B_Raw_mA,
    PV_High := 900.0,
    PV_Low := 50.0,
    Scaling_Slope := 62.5,
    Scaling_Offset := -250.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
LIT_601(
    Raw_Signal := LIT601_Raw_mA,
    Scaling_Slope := 6.25,
    Scaling_Offset := -25.0,
    Alarm_Enable := TRUE);
LT_601(
    Raw_Signal := LT601_Raw_mA,
    Scaling_Slope := 6.25,
    Scaling_Offset := -25.0);
HS_601(
    Bool_In := HS601_HandSwitch_IN,
    Alarm_OnTrue := TRUE);
FIC_601B(
    AUTO := TRUE,
    PV := FT_601B.PV,
    SP := FFIC_601.SlaveSP,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 100.0,
    X0 := 0.0,
    Deviation_Limit := 100.0,
    Inhibit := LIT_601.High_Alarm);
RatioControlInhibit := HS_601.Alarm_Active OR LIT_601.High_Alarm OR FT_601A.Low_Alarm OR FT_601A.General_Fault OR FT_601B.General_Fault OR FIC_601B.Deviation_Alarm;
FFIC_601(
    Auto := TRUE,
    PrimaryPV := FT_601A.PV,
    SecondaryPV := FT_601B.PV,
    RatioSP := 0.2,
    Bias := 0.0,
    TrimKp := 0.0,
    TrimTi := T#0s,
    MV_MIN := 0.0,
    MV_MAX := 1000.0,
    ManOut := 0.0,
    Inhibit := RatioControlInhibit);
FV_601B(
    Control_Signal := FIC_601B.XOUT,
    Manual_Mode := FALSE,
    Manual_Position := 0.0,
    Open_Limit := 100.0,
    Close_Limit := 0.0,
    Timeout := T#5s,
    Inhibit := LIT_601.High_Alarm);
CompressorInhibit := LIT_601.Low_Alarm OR FV_601B.Alarm OR FT_601A.General_Fault OR FV_601B.Position_Error;
C_601(
    Inhibit := CompressorInhibit);

(* Outputs published to other sections / HMI. *)
FT601A_LNG_Flow_PV := FT_601A.PV;
FT601B_BOG_Flow_PV := FT_601B.PV;
FT601B_BOG_Flow_SP := FFIC_601.SlaveSP;
LIT601_TankLevel_PV := LIT_601.PV;
LT601_TankLevel_PV := LT_601.PV;

(* Entry point required by OpenPLC Editor v4. The process sections run as parallel program instances under task0; main only provides a scan heartbeat. *)
Heartbeat := NOT Heartbeat;
